name: Flickering Television
text: Before you choose whether to bid blind nil, look at the aces and face cards in your hand.
timing: When you bid (the blind nil decision, before the deal)
archetypes: Blind Bidder; splash Nil Champion, Nil Guard
decision: Whether a hand whose every high card you know is safe enough to go blind for ±200 (±300 with Clouded Eight Ball).
opponent: The peek is private and the blind nil is public as usual; opponents play against it exactly as against any blind nil.
aiNote: Bid blind nil when you hold no aces and at most one face card, or when the team is far behind and you hold no aces or kings.
rationale: The aces and face cards are what break a nil, so seeing them all screens out nearly every bad blind hand and lifts survival on the blind nils you take from about 0.65 to about 0.85. That is worth about +40 points a round with Desperate Gambit, more with Clouded Eight Ball (OR-U07), plus steadier blind-nil gold.
deviation: Changed from looking at four random cards, which gave too little to act on for a rare.
